correctness.rationale: PASS: Spatial Parseval gives S²+2Σ_h|B_h(t)|². For fixed positive lag h, the time-frequency difference between indices m+r and m is 3hr(2m+h+r)>0, so continuous t integration drops all off-diagonal terms; uniform N-sampling retains exactly N-divisible differences. Pairing conjugates gives the factor 4 and correct coefficient ordering, including signed possible defect. N|3hr(2m+h+r) reduces exactly to t|2m+h+r, with t=(N/gcd(N,3))/gcd(N/gcd(N,3),hr); solvability and bounded least solution are necessary and sufficient. Taking all a_n=1 detects any alias; magnitude Cauchy–Schwarz proves C=2−1/K iff alias-free. For p>=2K−3 all positive factors are too small; for p<2K−3, p=2,3 use (h,r,m)=(1,1,0), p>=5 use (1,2,(p−3)/2); K<=3 exceptions handled. Independent direct Gaussian-integer frequency quadruple enumeration reproduced the complete signed defect in 261 (K,N) cases, K=1..9 and N=1..29. Proof itself covers infinite parameters.
